'''S2-36B''' was a one-armed bronze-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who worked for [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] entrepreneur [[Kelko]] as the general translator in the [[Grande Game]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], a [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]]. The accuracy of her translations often depended on the generosity of the tips she received.
